_comment: Full 44-case career map. status:'authored' means a matching file exists under data/cases/ and is playable now; status:'planned' is a locked placeholder — title/teaser only, no case file yet, safe to show in the hub without spoiling anything. order_in_rank must be contiguous per rank_required (validate.mjs enforces this and cross-checks 'authored' entries against data/cases/*.json).

cases.title: First Day
cases.teaser: Your first ride-along. Someone's bike didn't just wander off.

cases.title: Five Finger Discount
cases.teaser: A corner store's register is short and the owner has three stories.

cases.title: Broken Window
cases.teaser: Vandalism, or something dressed up to look like it.

cases.title: Water Damage
cases.teaser: A landlord's insurance claim doesn't hold up under a flashlight.

cases.title: Open House
cases.teaser: Nothing was taken. That's the problem.

cases.title: Ride Along
cases.teaser: Last case before the badge upgrade — and it's not as simple as it looked on paper.

cases.title: Paper Trail
cases.teaser: A fraud complaint that keeps pointing at a company that doesn't seem to exist.

cases.title: Familiar Face
cases.teaser: A witness swears they've seen someone from your own precinct somewhere they shouldn't have been.

cases.title: Smash and Grab
cases.teaser: A jewelry store heist that was over in ninety seconds flat.

cases.title: Quiet Neighbor
cases.teaser: The building's quietest tenant just became its most interesting.

cases.title: Paper Cut
cases.teaser: A forged signature, a missing notary, and a very annoyed bank.

cases.title: Short Lease
cases.teaser: A storage unit rented for one month, paid in full, never opened by anyone you can find.

cases.title: Second Opinion
cases.teaser: Two witnesses, two stories, and only one of them is lying.

cases.title: Open and Shut
cases.teaser: Everyone wants this one closed by end of day. That's exactly why you shouldn't.

cases.title: Dead Drop
cases.teaser: Cash changed hands in an alley that has no cameras and, somehow, three witnesses.

cases.title: Night Shift
cases.teaser: A warehouse break-in with a suspiciously convenient guard schedule.

cases.title: Burned Bridge
cases.teaser: An arson case where the insurance payout is bigger than the building was worth.

cases.title: Double Entry
cases.teaser: Two sets of books, and only one of them was meant for you to find.

cases.title: Repeat Offender
cases.teaser: Same MO, different name, three years apart.

cases.title: House Call
cases.teaser: A home invasion where the victim is oddly reluctant to press charges.

cases.title: Second Story
cases.teaser: A rooftop entry too clean for a first-timer.

cases.title: Closing Time
cases.teaser: A bar owner's disappearance the night before an audit.

cases.title: Recanted
cases.teaser: Your key witness just changed their story, and not because they remembered wrong.

cases.title: Conflict of Interest
cases.teaser: Everyone involved has a reason to want this case to go away quietly.

cases.title: Notarized
cases.teaser: A stamp that's supposed to mean something doesn't mean what it's supposed to.

cases.title: Chain of Custody
cases.teaser: Evidence went missing between the scene and the lab. Somebody in the chain is lying.

cases.title: The Long Game
cases.teaser: A scheme three years in the making, unraveling because of one impatient mistake.

cases.title: First Body
cases.teaser: Your first homicide. Your partner steers you away from one thread without quite saying why.

cases.title: Last Call
cases.teaser: A bartender's final shift, and the last person to see him alive isn't talking.

cases.title: Cleanup Crew
cases.teaser: A scene too clean to be an accident, and too professional to be a first offense.

cases.title: Close to Home
cases.teaser: This one hits closer to the precinct than anyone's comfortable admitting.

cases.title: Second Glance
cases.teaser: A cold trail warms up the moment you stop looking where everyone told you to look.

cases.title: Loose Ends
cases.teaser: A cleanup job gone wrong leaves behind exactly the kind of paperwork it shouldn't have.

cases.title: The Wrong Door
cases.teaser: Someone on the inside gave a very specific address to the wrong people.

cases.title: Burned Out
cases.teaser: A fire meant to destroy evidence instead preserved exactly the wrong page.

cases.title: Paper Tiger
cases.teaser: The network's paperwork finally gets a face attached to it.

cases.title: Task Force
cases.teaser: Three agencies, one case, and nobody agreeing on jurisdiction.

cases.title: Wire and Fire
cases.teaser: A financial crime and an arson that turn out to be the same case wearing two hats.

cases.title: Familiar Hand
cases.teaser: A handwriting match comes back with a name you weren't ready to see.

cases.title: The Long Con
cases.teaser: A confidence scheme that's been running so long it's practically load-bearing.

cases.title: No Witnesses
cases.teaser: Everyone who could talk has already decided not to.

cases.title: The Ledger
cases.teaser: The full picture, on paper, at last.

cases.title: The Last Favor
cases.teaser: One more small ask before the wheels come off.

cases.title: Run the Case
cases.teaser: Everything, all at once, and no partner to lean on but the one you chose to trust.
